definitions: how good or bad something is:
the level of enjoyment , comfort , and health in someone's life :
used to refer to things that make a computer program , game , etc. easier to use:
a characteristic or feature of someone or something:
examples: a shop advertising top quality electrical goods
The food was of such poor quality.
The cuts could result in a lower quality of service .
Their products are of very high quality.
The food is good quality and nutritious .
I only buy good-quality wine .

definitions: a sentence or phrase used to find out information :
in an exam , a problem that tests a person's knowledge or ability :
any matter that needs to be dealt with or considered :
the person or thing that is being discussed :
examples: The police asked me questions all day .
Why won't you answer my question?
"So where is the missing money ?" "That's a good question." (= I don't know the answer .)
There will be a question-and-answer session (= a period when people can ask questions)
Answer/Do as many questions as you can.
This raises the question of teacher pay .

definitions: used to express that you are not certain about something:
used to show agreement with someone's opinion :
used to emphasize the degree or amount of something, or to say that someone or something is impressive , interesting , or unusual :
examples: The two situations are quite different.
The colours almost match but not quite.
I enjoyed her new book though it's not
Are you quite sure you want to go?
Quite honestly / frankly
I don't quite know what to say.

definitions: after only a very short time :
examples: We'll have to walk quickly to get there on time .
Quickly now, you two, daddy's waiting in the car !
He replied very quickly.
He quickly realized that she wasn't telling the truth .
